summary: @ornikar/prismic-components preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine) and thousands of hex-encoded constants — an opaque, obfuscated payload that cannot be inspected without executing it under Bun. The package has no library surface consistent with its advertised name: `description` and `author` are empty, `main` points at an `index.js` that is absent from the tarball, and the only functional artifact is the preinstall dropper plus its obfuscated payload. The `@ornikar` scope belongs to a real company, and this artifact carries the shape of a dependency-confusion / scope-squat lure against that scope. Installing this package triggers automatic execution of attacker-controlled, obfuscated code under a smuggled alternate runtime on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
